---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using invented sample data.
---

## What happened

Describe the expected result and the actual result.

## Reproduce

Give the command, Python version, operating system, `channelrecap doctor` output and
error text. Replace personal paths and source links with placeholders. If possible,
include a small invented caption example.

Do not paste private transcripts, recordings or personal data.
